name: ATIP signal engine (W2 code strategy)
description: Follows the signal engine directly: BUY rows of ai_scores (scores/engine.py determine_signal), best ATIP score first; a SELL signal on a held symbol exits. Note: ai_scores history is today's formulas re-applied to the past, so backtests of this strategy carry that caveat.

parameters.name: exit_on_sell_signal
parameters.description: Exit a holding on a SELL signal
